summary: Evolution Petroleum filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, reporting fiscal fourth-quarter and full-year results for the period ended June 30, 2026 via press release (Item 2.02), and disclosing a declared quarterly dividend of $0.12 per common share (Item 8.01). The dividend is payable September 30, 2026 to holders of record September 21, 2026. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings release plus ordinary capital-return declaration; no deal or special-situation mechanics are present.
